integrity: Analytic strong-Markov/renewal proof, exact symbolic identity, high-precision mixed Laplace derivatives and separate finite-lattice generator calculations; finite experiments are not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional driftless Brownian motion, complete exponential resetting to a point strictly between two targets, persistent process after either first visit; not asserted for killed first exit, target-triggered reset, non-Poisson clocks, or other Markov processes. The independent scientific audit has not been performed and global publication priority remains uncertain.
title: Strict anticorrelation of opposite Brownian first-passage clocks under Poisson resetting
